violations.description: HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): The hand washing lavatory in the kitchen noted being used for other than hand washing. Observed employee rinsing off potatoes in the chinese area hand wash sink. A waste receptacle was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the food prep area for the main kitchen and chinese area. .
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Reachin cooler interior not properly maintained. Absorbent pads on interior of prep top cooler are not easily cleaned non-absorbent surfaces.

POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of noodles and ingredients in the walk in cooler was noted not being properly dated for disposition.
CONTAMINATION FROM WIPING CLOTHS (2 pts): Wiping cloths noted laying on counter in kitchen and on cutting board of prep top cooler.
